value.visual-studio-code-1-133-released: VS Code 1.133 ships improved AI-assisted refactoring, native Jupyter, and deep GitHub Copilot agent mode terminal integration, adding multi-cursor inline chat suggestions.
value.visual-studio-code-1-134-insiders-previe: VS Code 1.134 Insiders build introduces experimental custom AI model provider support for Copilot, enhanced multi-file diff viewing, and semantic ranking in extension marketplace search.
value.azure-databricks-runtime-10-4-lts-reachi: Azure Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS reaches end of life November 1, 2026, ceasing security patches and support; migration to a supported version is mandatory.
value.stripe-reportedly-acquiring-ai-gateway-s: Stripe is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire OpenRouter, an AI model gateway for routing requests across frontier APIs, for over $7 billion.
value.openai-introduces-ultrafast-mode-making-: OpenAI's new 'Ultrafast' mode for GPT-5.6 Sol delivers 14x faster inference via speculative decoding and hardware batching, available in the API.
value.microsoft-kills-unsuccessful-ai-features: Microsoft is discontinuing underperforming AI features, including Cortana integrations and Copilot sidebar modes, while unifying consumer and enterprise Copilot apps within 90 days.
value.vulnerability-giving-attackers-full-cont: A critical macOS vulnerability, actively exploited in the wild, allows full system takeover by bypassing SIP and gaining kernel access; Apple released an emergency patch.
value.terabytes-of-credentials-leaked-in-massi: A large-scale supply-chain attack compromised npm/PyPI packages, exfiltrating terabytes of credentials, API keys, and session tokens; dozens of affected packages are yanked.
value.chrome-adopts-what-may-be-the-best-prote: Chrome 130+ defaults to Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC), cryptographically binding authentication cookies to devices, rendering stolen cookies worthless for session hijacking.
value.openai-and-anthropic-in-price-war-as-chi: OpenAI and Anthropic cut API prices 30-50% across model tiers, responding to competitive pressure from Chinese AI rivals offering comparable performance at lower costs.
